res: cold, fire, lightning; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.d:
The glabrezu's spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 16). The glabrezu can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: darkness, detect magic, dispel magic
1/day each: confusion, fly, power word stun
The glabrezu has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.d: The glabrezu makes four attacks: two with its pincers and two with its fists. Alternatively, it makes two attacks with its pincers and casts one spell.

Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 15). The glabrezu has two pincers, each of which can grapple only one target.
Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

The demon chooses what to summon and attempts a magical summoning.
A glabrezu has a 30 percent chance of summoning 1d3 vrocks, 1d2 hezrous, or one glabrezu.
A summoned demon appears in an unoccupied space within 60 feet of its summoner, acts as an ally of its summoner, and can't summon other demons. It remains for 1 minute, until it or its summoner dies, or until its summoner dismisses it as an action.

tips: Иммунитет к урону: poison — не тратьте на это ресурсы, ищите другой тип урона.
Сопротивление урону: cold, fire, lightning; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks — вполовину менее эффективно, предпочтите другой тип.
Иммунитет к состояниям: poisoned — заклинания/эффекты с такими состояниями не подействуют.
Заклинатель — по возможности используйте Немоту (Silence), прерывание заклинаний (Counterspell) или атаку в упор, чтобы сорвать компоненты.
Мультиатака — наносит несколько ударов за ход. Эффекты обездвиживания/оглушения особенно ценны против него.
